name: Santé aero brake-lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 266 g for the complete left/right BL-5001 aero lever pair; 97.5 mm lever reach. The source lists 23.8 and 24.2 mm clamp options without identifying the weighed clamp size.
